name: Self-Watering Smart Plant System
title: Self-watering plant system (alt to a $129 smart auto-waterer)

originalProduct.name: Smart Wi-Fi Automatic Drip Irrigation & Reservoir System

summary: A closed-loop automatic plant irrigation system combining a 3D-printed 1.4L modular reservoir, snap-fit port lid, submersible pump isolation cradle, ESP32 controller enclosure, silicone tubing clips, and soil drip emitter stakes with $29 of off-the-shelf electronics.
function: Monitors root-zone soil moisture continuously using a corrosion-resistant capacitive probe and triggers a quiet 5V submersible micro-pump through food-grade 4/6mm silicone tubing to deliver precise water doses directly to plant stakes.
mechanisms: Capacitive dielectric soil moisture sensing (3.3V analog feedback)
5V PWM/MOSFET switched centrifugal submersible micro-pump (120 L/h)
Gravity-isolated top-refill funnel and anti-siphon tubing guide clips
Root-zone targeted stake drippers with manual rotary flow restrictor wheel
